name: Turnitin
tagline: Turnitin is the world's leading academic integrity platform, now with an AI writing detection capability that identifies text generated by ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs with high accuracy. Used by over 16,000 educational institutions, it helps educators assess authentic learning while adapting to the era of generative AI.
